nodes.title: Actual image observation · saved
widgets_values:
Saved observation by gemini-4-argon of male-6.jpg (reference) and male-9.jpg (candidate). These are existing example photographs.

Both photographs show subjects with short dark hair standing and facing the camera in a medium shot. Several visible features change between the images:

*   **Clothing and colors:** The reference (Image 1) shows a tucked-in black button-down shirt and textured gray trousers. The candidate (Image 2) features an open light-gray collared jacket over a white and tan color-blocked t-shirt, dark pants, and a silver cross necklace.
*   **Hairstyle:** Image 1 shows thick black hair brushed upward, while Image 2 has shorter dark hair with closely faded sides.
*   **Glasses:** No glasses appear in Image 1, whereas black rectangular glasses are worn in Image 2.
*   **Facial hair:** Image 1 displays a short dark beard and mustache; Image 2 shows no visible facial hair.
*   **Pose:** In Image 1, the subject smiles showing teeth with both hands in pockets. In Image 2, the subject has a closed-mouth expression with arms hanging at the sides.
*   **Background:** Image 1 has a plain white backdrop, while Image 2 shows an outdoor urban scene with a yellow transit vehicle and a building.
